verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes grey field appearance as a visible UI cue identifying where users must enter information.
The freelancer reports that grey fields are tied to password-protected editing, creating a material unresolved conflict over the suitable visual-cue mechanism.
The client requires visible in-field placeholder text so an unfilled field remains identifiable and permits the same help text to appear in its label.
The client resolves the cue-mechanism uncertainty by confirming that visible text may remain both inside the field and in its label.
The message reports placeholder-clearing failures in several documents, not a scope change to visual identification cues; those observations belong to the placeholder-clear behavior.
